faults.quote: cover both western-style bread and various sweet or savory pastries, cakes, and buns.
faults.why: False claim: cakes and pastries are 'kue', not 'roti' (which covers bread and buns/rolls).
Bread loaves and filled bread buns/rolls are one concept in Indonesian; 'pastry' is misleading.
